headline: Elected Chair, Vice-Chair, and Clerk, approved rules and forms, and scheduled appeal hearings for October 16, 2026.
summary: The Board of Tax Appeals held its organizational meeting, electing officers and approving hearing rules and forms. It also set a single panel schedule for three property tax appeals on October 16, 2026.
decisions: Elected Alan Bjerke as Chair, unanimously.
Elected Meg McGovern as Vice-Chair with 5 votes to David Maher's 2 votes.
Elected Lori Olberg as Clerk, unanimously.
Approved the hearing procedures rules, unanimously.
Approved the Educational Brochure, Notice of Hearing, Authority of Representation, Waiver of Site Visit, and Official Notice of Decision forms as presented, unanimously.
Established one panel to hear all three appeals on Friday, October 16, 2026, from 1 pm to 4 pm.

decision_evidence.quote: Board Member McGovern nominated Alan Bjerke to be the Chair. Motion passed unanimously.

Board Member McGovern received 5 votes: Board Members Maher, Commo, Eley, Hurley and Bjerke. Board Member Maher received 2 votes: Board Members McGovern and Fuller. Board Member McGovern was elected to be the Vice-Chair.
Board Member Eley nominated Lori Olberg to be the Clerk. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Vice-Chair McGovern, seconded by Board Member Hurley, to approve the rules. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Fuller, seconded by Vice-Chair McGovern, to approve the forms as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
One panel for all appeals was scheduled for Friday, October 16, 2026, Bushor Conference Room, 1 pm - 4 pm
